story:
Angels tell shepherds that Jesus the Savior is born, and the shepherds hurry to see Him and tell everyone. Grandpa Sol tells the Christmas story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end. Christmas is about Jesus, God's greatest gift! (Luke 2:8-20)

Memory line: Good news is for sharing!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: Who sang in the sky? (The angels!)
Ages 4-8: What did the angel tell the shepherds? Where did they find baby Jesus? What good news can we share this Christmas?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for sending Jesus. Help us share the good news with everyone. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Make a paper star, and tell one person the good news that Jesus was born.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Shepherds on the hill at night
Watching sheep by firelight
Suddenly the sky was bright
An angel came with shining light

[Chorus]
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Jesus is born, our Savior is here
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Joy to the world, the news is so dear!

[Verse 2]
"Do not fear," the angel said
"Find a baby in a little bed"
Angels singing, "Glory above!"
Peace on earth and God's great love

[Chorus]
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Jesus is born, our Savior is here
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Joy to the world, the news is so dear!

[Verse 3]
Hurry, hurry, down the hill
Little stable, quiet and still
Baby Jesus, soft and small
We bow down, we love You all

[Chorus - lifted]
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Jesus is born, our Savior is here
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Joy to the world, the news is so dear!

[Outro]
Go and tell it, tell it gladly
Jesus is here!
Jesus is here!
